theme: Light theme preferable with dark mode toggle

rules: Line height: leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body.

colors.archetype: Organic & Earthy (Modified for Food with Terracotta appetite-stimulating primary)

visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for buttons/pills.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Sticky header MUST use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70. DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), solid primary for main actions, subtle ghost for secondary.
components.cards: Image takes 40% (left or top), content 60%. Hover: -translate-y-1 with expanded shadow.
components.navigation: Sticky top navbar. Bottom nav for mobile is recommended for food apps.
components.cart_drawer: Shadcn Sheet component triggered from nav.
components.stepper: Vertical or horizontal timeline for order status (Placed -> Preparing -> Out for Delivery -> Delivered).

layouts.home: Hero section with large mouth-watering image. Horizontal scroll for categories. Bento grid for featured items.
layouts.menu: Filterable grid (1 col mobile, 2-3 col desktop) with category sticky sidebar.
layouts.admin: Sidebar navigation. High-density grid for metrics. Standard tables for order management.
layouts.order_tracking: Centered card with map placeholder and status stepper.

rules: Use hover states on all interactive elements.
Page load staggered fade-up for menu items.

image_urls.description: White bowl filled with biryani rice and meat

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
accessibility.focus_states: Must have HIGHER contrast than default state.

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states separate good from extraordinary.
NEVER use placeholder text for images. Use the provided image_urls.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
The codebase uses .js files, NOT .tsx. Adjust imports and syntax accordingly.
Ensure optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
Use the 'Bento' Grid Protocol for the home page. Do not use generic 'Bootstrap' columns.

instructions_to_main_agent.stack: MERN stack hybrid_fullstack with Tailwind and Shadcn UI in React (.js files).
instructions_to_main_agent.key_features: Landing page, Menu browsing with filters, Cart drawer, Checkout, Order tracking stepper, Auth (JWT+Google), Admin dashboard.
instructions_to_main_agent.tech_details: Implement the UI using .js files as it's a standard MERN app frontend, not TS. Provide the necessary shadcn/framer-motion wrappers in plain JS.
